mr_title: Handle Content-Length in ShallowEtagHeaderFilter more robustly
mr_description:
This commit ensures that setting the Content-Length through
setHeader("Content-Length", x") has the same effect as calling
setContentLength in the ShallowEtagHeaderFilter. It also filters out
Content-Type headers similarly to Content-Length.

expected_issues.title: Deferred Content-Type loses header and charset semantics
expected_issues.description:
Content-Type is now stored only on the wrapper until copyBodyToResponse() forwards a non-empty cached body. Empty responses and paths that bypass body caching can therefore lose the header. getContentType() also returns only the local field, hiding a type already set on the wrapped response.

The setter no longer informs the underlying response of a charset either, while getWriter() obtains its encoding from that response. A declared charset can consequently disagree with the bytes written. Preserve delegated Content-Type and charset semantics, including when there is no cached body to copy.
